cases.description: Complete project evidence produces a useful update.

evidence.observation: The production pack was approved on 2026-08-21 and the project update is due.

generated_response.reasoning_summary: The dated approval is a meaningful project change and supports one traceable update.

reference_points: Complete evidence must create a useful output reference.
The reasoning must cite the observed approval rather than a provider-side effect.

cases.description: A complete query with no eligible changes returns no_change_needed.

evidence.observation: The frozen Project Notes contain no unresolved Work or documentation question to carry forward.

generated_response.reasoning_summary: The required Project Notes were checked successfully and contain no eligible carry-forward, so no output is needed.

reference_points: No change is valid only after the required source was checked.

cases.description: An otherwise actionable commitment without an owner cannot be safely extracted.

evidence.observation: The commitment names the action and due date but does not identify an accountable owner.

generated_response.reasoning_summary: A Task cannot be assigned safely because the required owner is absent from the checked Meeting evidence.

information_gaps.why_needed: The Task contract requires one accountable owner.
information_gaps.where_to_add: Add the owner to the explicit commitment in the Meeting record.
information_gaps.question: Who owns this commitment?

reference_points: Missing required evidence must not be treated as no change.
The gap must say what is missing, why it matters, where to fix it, and what to ask.
